name: How to Edit Text in a PDF
description: Fix a typo or small text change inside a PDF — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose file' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. Its pages open as they are.

step.name: Click the text you want to fix
step.text: Tap any line, retype it, and press Enter. The new text must fit the space of that line.

step.name: Save and download
step.text: Click 'Save'. Only the edited lines are replaced in the original PDF, every changed page is checked, and the file downloads.
